cloudflare_origin_recommendation.public_ui: sqlolla.us static frontend using Cloudflare Pages or equivalent static assets
cloudflare_origin_recommendation.api: api.sqlolla.us routes through Cloudflare/Tunnel to a native/container origin
cloudflare_origin_recommendation.ordinary_workers: Do not place the JVM/Alloy SAT computation in an ordinary Worker isolate. Current documented memory is 128 MB/isolate; paid CPU defaults to 30 seconds and can be raised to 5 minutes.
cloudflare_origin_recommendation.job_transport: Return 202 with authorized job ID; poll or stream progress; computation does not depend on a single request remaining open.
cloudflare_origin_recommendation.private_mode: Same native/container origin can serve frontend locally with Cloudflare, AI and external telemetry disabled.
cloudflare_origin_recommendation.TLS: Keep origin certificate verification enabled. Hosted BYOT must disclose that the origin and Cloudflare TLS path handle the request; no key logging.
